source_handle: 15 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was performed, the pulp was removed, the pulp roof was uncovered, and the root canal was dredged. The root length was measured to be 19mm. Glyde assisted the machine and prepared the machine with nickel-titanium to 0625. The rubber dam was used to isolate moisture at 1% and 3%. Rinse with sodium hypochlorite, rinse with ultrasonic waves, blot dry, and seal the root canal with calcium hydroxide paste and temporary ion sealing. 25 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Prepare the machine with nickel-titanium to 0625 with the assistance of Glyde, rinse with 1% and 3% sodium hypochlorite under a rubber dam to isolate moisture, rinse with ultrasonic, and blot dry.
